Culture Day 2025/26

An annual tradition

Ethiopia's cultures, worn and danced on our own campus.

Once a year, classrooms give way to Ethiopia's many regional dress, hairstyles, and dance. Culture Day 2025/26 brought students out in traditional attire from across the country's cultures, ending in shared dancing in the school hall.
